distanthorizons.config.client.qualityPre:
Zimasintha zosankha zingapo za kujambula kuti isinthe mwachangu ubwino wa kujambula kwa Distant Horizons.

Tsitsani kusankha kumeneku ngati GPU yanu ili pa ntchito yaikulu kapena mukukumana ndi mavuto a framerate.
distanthorizons.config.client.threadPres:
Zimasintha kuchuluka kwa ma threads omwe Distant Horizons adzagwiritsa ntchito.

Kupititsa patsogolo kusankha kumeneku kudzawonjezera liwiro la Distant Generator ndi liwiro la kutsitsa LOD,
koma lidzawonjezeranso kugwiritsa ntchito CPU/memory ndipo lingayambitse stuttering.

Zindikirani: Izi ndi zokhudzana ndi CPU.
Izi ziyenera kuyika kupanikizika kofanana pa CPU ya 2 cores monga pa CPU ya 64 cores.
distanthorizons.config.client.optionsBut: Onetsani batani la zokonza kumanzere kwa batani la fov
distanthorizons.config.client.advanced.g: Unyambo wa Mtunda Wopereka Chunk ya LOD

Mtunda wa kujambula wa Distant Horizons, woyezedwa mu chunks.

Zindikirani: limeneli ndi manambala oyesetsa.
Mtunda weniweni wa kujambula ungakhale wapamwamba kapena wochepa pa manambala amenewa
ndipo zimatengera zosankha zina zanu za graphics.

Izi zikuwonetsa kuti kuchepa kwa ubwino wa LOD kuli patali bwanji.

Zosankha zapamwamba zidzawonjezera mtunda pakati pa kuchepa
koma zidzawonjezera kugwiritsa ntchito memory ndi GPU.

Ubwino wapamwamba kwambiri wa LOD zomwe zingajambulidwe.

§6Yofulumira Kwambiri:§r Chunk
§6Yosangalatsa Kwambiri:§r Block

Momwe LOD zikuyimira bwino zokhotakhota, mapanga, malire, ndi zina.

Zosankha zapamwamba zidzawonjezera kugwiritsa ntchito memory ndi GPU.
Gwiritsani ntchito Camera Pos ya Quality Drop-Off

Ngati zowona, DH idzayesa kugwiritsa ntchito malo a kamera pamene
ikudziwa kuchepa kwa ubwino wa LOD.
Ngati zonama, DH idzagwiritsa ntchito malo a wosewera.

Kuyatsa kumathandiza ma free-cam mods kujambula molondola.
Kuzimitsa kumathandiza ma multi-camera mods kujambula molondola (mwachitsanzo Immersive Portals kapena ma camera mods).

Ngati zowona, ubwino wa LOD udzakwezedwa pamene kamera yazoomed in,
mwachitsanzo pamene mukugwiritsa ntchito spyglass kapena zoom mod.

LOD zokhala zowonekera kudzera pazowonera za kamera ndizomwe zimakhudzidwa.

Pamene zozoomed in, LOD zidzatsitsikira ku detail level yomweyo
yomwe zikanakhala naleyo mukadakhala pafupi nazo.

Kuchuluka kwa detail levels komwe kuzooming in kungakweze ubwino wa LOD ndi kotani.
Manambala apamwamba amalola kuti zooms zamphamvu zijambule dziko lombatata,
koma adzawonjezera kugwiritsa ntchito memory ndi GPU pamene zozoomed in.

Spyglass ya vanilla ikufuna detail levels 4 kuti ifikire ubwino wake wonse.

Momwe LOD zikutsika mwachangu mu ubwino.

Manambala akulu adzathandiza kuti zithunzi zakutali ziwezeke bwino
koma zidzawonjezera kugwiritsa ntchito memory ndi GPU.

Tanthauzani momwe LOD ziyenera kuthimbidwa.
Zingagwiritsidwe ntchito kukonza kugwirizana ndi ma shader.
Kodi mbali ndi pansi pa LOD za grass block ziyenera kujambulidwa bwanji?

If true nearby LODs will render blocks with their real shape 
instead of full cubes. 
If false all LODs render as full cubes. 

Only applies to the highest detail LODs.
Fema Ma LOD a DH Apafupi

Ngati zowona, LOD zidzafema pamene mukuyandikira.
Ngati zonama, LOD zidzadulidwa mwadzidzidzi pa mtunda wokhazikika kuchokera ku kamera.
Kusankha kumeneku kumakhudzidwa ndi kukonza kwa vanilla overdraw prevention.

Kodi vanilla Minecraft iyenera kulowa mu LOD za Distant Horizons bwanji?

NONE: Yothamanga kwambiri, padzakhala malire owonekera pakati pa kujambula kwa DH ndi MC.
SINGLE_PASS: Fade amachitika pambuyo pa pass yowonekera ya MC, opaque blocks pansi pa madzi sadzafema.
DOUBLE_PASS: Yocheperako, fade amachitika pambuyo pa passes zonse zowonekera ndi zowonekera za MC, ndipo ndi njira yosalala kwambiri.
Fade Pamaso pa Far Clip Plane

Kodi DH iyenera kufema isanafike pa far clip plane?
Izi zimathandiza kuletsa mitambo ya DH kuti isadule patali.

Momwe mitundu ya LOD ili yowala.

0 = wakuda
1 = wamba
2 = pafupi ndi woyera

Momwe mitundu ya LOD ili yotsekemera.

0 = wakuda ndi woyera
1 = wamba
2 = wowoneka bwino

Izi ndi zofanana ndi vanilla Biome Blending settings pa malo a LOD.

Zindikirani: chilichonse pamwamba pa '0' chidzachepetsa liwiro la kutsitsa LOD.

'0' ndi yofanana ndi Vanilla Biome Blending ya '1x1',
'1' ndi yofanana ndi Vanilla Biome Blending ya '3x3',
'2' ndi yofanana ndi Vanilla Biome Blending ya '5x5'...
Ambient Occlusion imawonjezera kuya mu kuwala kwa blocks.
Kuyatsa Anti-Aliasing kumagwira m'mphepete mwa malire ndikuchepetsa kuthimba kwa kujambula mukasamuka.

Ngati zowona, zinthu zomwe si za terrain zidzajambulidwa ndi DH.
mwachitsanzo mitsinje ya beacon ndi mitambo.
Zikhoza kutalikitsa katatu kuti beacon ijambulidwe. Zimafuna kuyambitsanso dziko kuti zigwire ntchito.

Ngati zowona, mitsinje ya LOD beacon idzajambulidwa yokulirapo pa mtunda waulitali,
kuti ziwoneke mosavuta.
Ngati zonama, mitsinje yonse ya LOD beacon idzakhala ya block imodzi yokha.
Ngati zowona, mitsinje ya LOD beacon idzajambulidwa.
Ngati zowona, mitambo ya LOD idzajambulidwa.

Mndandanda wopatulidwa ndi makoma wa dimension resource locations komwe mitambo ya DH idzajambulidwa.

Mwachitsanzo: "minecraft:overworld,minecraft:the_end"

Zosintha zimafuna kuyambitsanso dziko.

Zonama = DH idzajambula gulu limodzi la mitambo, monga vanilla Minecraft.
Zowona = DH idzajambula magulu 3 a mitambo pa kutalika kosiyana.
Timatsimikiza ngati chifunga chikujambulidwa pa LOD za DH.

§6Zowona:§r Minecraft imajambula chifunga ngati zokhazikika.
§6Zonama:§r imatseka chifunga cha Minecraft pa vanilla chunks.

Zingayambitse mavuto ndi ma mod ena omwe amasintha chifunga.

Kodi chifunga chiyenera kuyambika kuti?

  '0.0': Chifunga chikuyambira pa malo a wosewera.
  '1.0': Bwalo la kuyambika kwa chifunga likukwanira bwino mu square ya render distance ya lod.
'1.414': Square ya render distance ya lod ikukwanira bwino mu bwalo la kuyambika kwa chifunga.

Kodi chifunga chiyenera kutha kuti?

  '0.0': Chifunga chikutha pa malo a wosewera.
  '1.0': Bwalo la kutha kwa chifunga likukwanira bwino mu square ya render distance ya lod.
'1.414': Square ya render distance ya lod ikukwanira bwino mu bwalo la kutha kwa chifunga.

Kodi kuchuluka kochepa kwambiri kwa chifunga ndi kotani?

  '0.0': Palibe chifunga konse.
  '1.0': Mtundu wonse wa chifunga.

Kodi kuchuluka kwakukulu kwambiri kwa chifunga ndi kotani?

  '0.0': Palibe chifunga konse.
  '1.0': Mtundu wonse wa chifunga.

Kodi kuchuluka kwa chifunga kuyenera kuwerengedwa bwanji?

LINEAR: Mzere wozikidwa pa mtunda (umanyalanyaza 'kuchuluka')
EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(distance*density))
EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((distance*density)^2))
Kodi kuchuluka kwa chifunga ndi kotani?

Tanthauzani momwe kutalika kumakhudzira chifunga.
Mukasaka, yambani ndi SPHERICAL, ADDITION, kapena MAX.

SPHERICAL: Chifunga chimawerengedwa mwazikidwa pa mtunda wa kamera.
CYLINDRICAL: Inyalanyaza kutalika, chifunga chimawerengedwa mwazikidwa pa mtunda wopingasa.
MAX: max(heightFog, farFog)
ADDITION: heightFog + farFog
MULTIPLY: heightFog * farFog
INVERSE_MULTIPLY: 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
LIMITED_ADDITION: farFog + max(farFog, heightFog)
MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + farFog * heightFog
INVERSE_MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
AVERAGE: farFog*0.5 + heightFog*0.5

Kodi height fog iyenera kukhala kuti?

ABOVE_CAMERA: Height fog imayambira pa kamera kupita kumwamba
BELOW_CAMERA: Height fog imayambira pa kamera kupita ku void
ABOVE_AND_BELOW_CAMERA: Height fog imayambira pa kamera kupita kumwamba ndi void
ABOVE_SET_HEIGHT: Height fog imayambira pa kutalika kokhazikika kupita kumwamba
BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: Height fog imayambira pa kutalika kokhazikika kupita ku void
ABOVE_AND_BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: Height fog imayambira pa kutalika kokhazikika kupita kumwamba ndi void
Ngati height fog ikuwerengedwa mozungulira kutalika kokhazikika, kodi kutalika kumeneko ndi kotani?

Kodi kuyambika kwa height fog kuyenera kupatutsidwa mtunda wotani?

  '0.0': Chifunga chimayambira popanda kupatutsa.
  '1.0': Chifunga chimayambira ndi kupatutsa kwa kutalika kwonse kwa dziko. (Kuphatikiza kuya)

Kodi kutha kwa height fog kuyenera kupatutsidwa mtunda wotani?

  '0.0': Chifunga chimatha popanda kupatutsa.
  '1.0': Chifunga chimatha ndi kupatutsa kwa kutalika kwonse kwa dziko. (Kuphatikiza kuya)

Kodi kuchuluka kochepa kwambiri kwa chifunga ndi kotani?

  '0.0': Palibe chifunga konse.
  '1.0': Mtundu wonse wa chifunga.

Kodi kuchuluka kwakukulu kwambiri kwa chifunga ndi kotani?

  '0.0': Palibe chifunga konse.
  '1.0': Mtundu wonse wa chifunga.

Kodi kuchuluka kwa height fog kuyenera kuwerengedwa bwanji?

LINEAR: Mzere wozikidwa pa kutalika (umanyalanyaza 'kuchuluka')
EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(height*density))
EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((height*density)^2))
Kodi kuchuluka kwa height fog ndi kotani?

Ngati zowona, LOD zapafupi ndi zozoomed in zidzajambulidwa ndi texture yeniweni ya block
ndi mawonekedwe ake mmalo mwa mtundu umodzi wathyathyathya.

Zimagwira ntchito pa LOD zapamwamba zokha pomwe texture imawonekera kwenikweni,
LOD zakutali nthawi zonse zimagwiritsa ntchito flat colors.
Palibe zotsatira pamene shader pack yatsegulidwa, chifukwa ma shader packs
amajambula LOD ndi mapulogalamu awoawo.

Nambala yapamwamba kwambiri ya detail level yomwe itha kujambulidwa ndi block textures.
Pa detail levels apamwamba, LOD iliyonse imaphatikiza mabuloko angapo,
kupangitsa ma texture kukhala ang'onoang'ono kuposa pixel ndipo choncho osaoneka.

Manambala apamwamba amajambula LOD zakutali kwambiri
koma amawonjezera kugwiritsa ntchito memory.

Mndandanda wopatulidwa ndi makoma wa block resource locations
omwe DH sidzajambula textures pawo.
Partial matches/ma resource locations osakwanira nawonso adzagwirizana.

Mwachitsanzo: "minecraft:grass_block,nylium"

Zosintha zimafuna kuyambitsanso.

Mndandanda wopatulidwa ndi makoma wa block resource locations
omwe DH idzajambula mbali zawo pogwiritsa ntchito texture yapansi.
Partial matches/ma resource locations osakwanira nawonso adzagwirizana.

Mwachitsanzo: "minecraft:grass_block,nylium"

Zosintha zimafuna kuyambitsanso.
Block Tags Osagwiritsa Ntchito Side Texture

Mndandanda wopatulidwa ndi makoma wa tag names
omwe DH idzajambula mbali zawo pogwiritsa ntchito texture yapansi.

Mwachitsanzo: "grass_blocks,nylium"

Zosintha zimafuna kuyambitsanso.
Mabuloko Omwe Amagwiritsa Nthawi Zonse Rasterize Texture

Mndandanda wopatulidwa ndi makoma wa block resource locations
omwe DH idzagwiritsa ntchito rasterization kuti adziwe
ma face textures.

Angagwiritsidwe ntchito kuthana ndi mavuto ndi ma mod/mabuloko pomwe
mbali imagwiritsa ntchito gawo kokha la texture ya block yoyesedwa.

Mwachitsanzo: "minecraft:beacon"

Zosintha zimafuna kuyambitsanso.
Ngati yatsegulidwa, noise texture idzagwiritsidwa ntchito pa LOD kuti iwonekere ngati textures.
Timatsimikiza kuchuluka kwa masitepe a noise omwe ayenera kugwiritsidwa ntchito pa LOD.
Timatsimikiza kuti noise texture ndi yamphamvu bwanji.

Tanthauzani kuti noise texture iyenera kujambulidwa mpaka kutali bwanji isanafeme. (mu mabuloko).
Ikani 0 kuti muzimitsa chifema cha noise.

Timatsimikiza kuti Distant Horizons iyambira kujambula patali bwanji kuchokera ku kamera.
Kuyezedwa ngati kuchuluka kwa vanilla render distance.
-1 = Zokha, zowonjezera zidzasintha mwazikidwa pa vanilla render distance.

Mikhalidwe yapamwamba idzateteza LOD kuti isajambulidwe kumbuyo kwa vanilla blocks pa mtunda wapamwamba,
koma ingayambitse mabowo kuwonekera mu LOD.
Mabowo amawonekera kwambiri mukawuluka mu dziko losatsegulidwa.

Kupititsa patsogolo vanilla render distance kumapangitsa kuti kusankha kumeneku kukhale kothandiza.

Ngati zikukhazikitsidwa kuti zowona, utali wa overdraw prevention udzayandikira
ku kamera pamene mukuwuluka/kusuntha mwachangu.

Izi zimathandiza kuchepetsa mavuto pomwe Minecraft singathe
kutsitsa kapena kupanga chunks mwachangu mokwanira kuti igwirizane ndi DH.

Ngati yatsegulidwa, mapanga adzadulidwa

Zambiri: Pakali pano izi zimadula nkhope zonse
zomwe zili ndi skylight value ya 0 pansi pa kutalika kwa cave culling mu dimensions
zomwe zilibe denga.
Kodi cave culling iyenera kuyambira pa Y value yanji?

Ngati zowona, ma beacon pafupi ndi kamera sadzajambulidwa kuti ateteze vanilla overdraw.
Ngati zonama, ma beacon onse adzajambulidwa.

Ngati zonama, LOD zomwe zili kunja kwa kamera ya wosewera
sizijambulidwa, zomwe zimathandiza GPU.
Ngati zowona, LOD zonse zimajambulidwa, ngakhale zomwe zili kumbuyo
kwa kamera ya wosewera, ndipo GPU imagwira ntchito yambiri.

Zimitsani izi ngati mukuwona LOD zikutha pakona zakamaso anu.

Zofanana ndi njira ina ya frustum culling koma
imangogwiritsidwa ntchito pamene pali shader mod pogwiritsa ntchito DH API
ndipo shadow pass ikujambulidwa.

Zimitsani izi ngati mithunzi ikujambulidwa molakwika.

Mndandanda wopatulidwa ndi makoma wa block resource locations omwe sadzajambulidwa ndi DH.
Air nthawi zonse amaphatikizidwa mu mndandanda uwu.

Zindikirani:
Ngati mukuwona mabowo, mutha kusintha
worldCompression kukhala [MERGE_SAME_BLOCKS] ndikupanganso ma LOD.

Mndandanda wopatulidwa ndi makoma wa block resource locations omwe sayenera kujambulidwa
ngati ali mu malo apansi panthaka a skylight 0.

§6NONE:§r Include all blocks in the LODs
§6NON_COLLIDING:§r Only render solid blocks in the LODs (tall grass, torches, etc. will be ignored)

§6Zonama:§r mabuloko osadutsidwa sadzasintha mtundu wa pamwamba pansi pawo

Ngati zowona, zosankha zina za vanilla graphics zidzasinthidwa zokha
panthawi ya kukhazikitsa kwa DH kuti apereke zokumana nazo zabwino.

Mwachitsanzo kutseka mitambo ya vanilla (yomwe imajambulidwa pamwamba pa LOD za DH),
ndi fade ya chunk (DH imafema MC chunks kale).

Mtengo wa 1 ndi wofanana ndi kupindika kwa Earth m'moyo weniweni.

Mndandanda wopatulidwa ndi makoma wa dimension resource locations komwe DH sidzajambula. Mwachitsanzo: "minecraft:the_nether,minecraft:the_end"

distanthorizons.config.client.advanced.a: Imasintha mod zokha pamene kupezeka kutsitsa

Nightly: Nightly builds kuchokera ku Gitlab.

distanthorizons.config.client.advanced.d:
Ngati yatsegulidwa, izi zimatseka (zambiri) za vanilla Minecraft rendering.

ZINDIKIRANI: Osanena za zovuta zilizonse pamene mode iyi yatsegulidwa!
Kusankha kumeneku ndi kwa kusangalala ndi kufufuza kokha.
Kugwirizana ndi ma mod sikutsimikizidwa.
Ngati yatsegulidwa, LOD zidzajambulidwa ngati wireframe.

Ngati zowona, makiyi angapo atha kugwiritsidwa ntchito kusintha debug states.
F6 - yatsani/zimitsani kujambula kwa LOD
F7 - yatsani/zimitsani kujambula kwa LOD kokha
F8 - sinthanani pakati pa njira zosiyanasiyana za debug rendering

Ngati yatsegulidwa, vertex color sadzadutsa.
Zothandiza pakufufuza ma shader.

Ngati zowona, overlapping quads zidzajambulidwa zofiyira kwambiri kuti zizindikirike mosavuta.
Ngati zonama, quads zidzajambulidwa mwachizolowezi.

Ngati zowona, OpenGL Buffer garbage collection idzalembedwa
ndipo ikuphatikizanso kuchuluka kwa live buffers.

Ngati yatsegulidwa, kutsimikizira kochepa kwambiri kwa config input kumachitika.

Chenjezo: kuyatsa izi kungayambitse kusakhazikika kapena crash, gwiritsani ntchito pa nthawi yanu.
Zindikirani: kusankha kumeneku sikusungidwa pakati pa zaka.
Ngati yatsegulidwa, ma wireframe osiyanasiyana othandizira kufufuza ntchito zamkati adjambulidwa.
Onetsani Network Sync On Load Queue

Tanthauzani momwe zolakwika za OpenGL zimathandizidwa.
Kumafuna kuyambitsanso Minecraft kuti zisinthe.
Zidzagwira zolakwika za OpenGL zoponyedwa ndi ma mod ena.
Lembani Zolakwika za GL Kamodzi Kokha

Ngati zowona, zolakwika zilizonse za Open GL zidzalembedwa kamodzi kokha.
Kuyatsa izi kungayambitse kuti zolemba zina za zolakwika zisalembedwe.
Sichichita kalikonse ngati overrideVanillaGLLogger yakhazikitsidwa ku zonama.
Ndipo nthawi zambiri izi zikhoza kukhala 'zowona' kuti ziletse log spam.
Komabe, chonde ikani izi ku 'zonama' ngati developer akufuna log yanu kuti afufuze GL vuto.

Tanthauzani momwe zolakwika za OpenGL zimathandizidwa.
Kumafuna kuyambitsanso Minecraft kuti zigwiritsidwe ntchito.

Yatsani Distant Generation

§6Zowona:§r mu single player LOD zidzapangidwa kunja kwa vanilla render distance.
Zimadalira pa Generator Mode, ma chunk omwe alipo kale amakhala ofunikira ndipo/kapena
ma chunk omwe akusowa adzapangidwa.
Zindikirani: izi zingagwiritse ntchito CPU yambiri.

§6Zonama:§r LOD zidzangopangidwa mkati mwa vanilla render distance.
Distant Generator Plan

Tanthauzani momwe LOD zidzapangidwira
kunja kwa vanilla render distance
mu singleplayer.

Zosankha zina mwina sizingakhaleko malinga ndi MC version.

§6SURFACE_THEN_CHUNKS§r
Yolimbikitsidwa kwa ma modded kapena vanilla worlds.

§6SURFACE_ONLY§r
Yolimbikitsidwa kwa makompyuta omwe alibe
CPU power yokwanira kapena RAM space kuti athane ndi
chunk generation.

§6CHUNKS_ONLY§r
Yolimbikitsidwa kwa custom worlds
pomwe surface generator ingapange
terrain wolakwika.

§6DISABLED§r
Yolimbikitsidwa ngati mukukumana ndi lag.
Chunk Generator Mode
Kodi generation iyenera kukhala yovuta bwanji popanga LOD kunja kwa vanilla render distance.
Yatsani Fast Surface Gen

Zimafuna kuyambitsanso dziko kuti zisinthe.

Ngati yatsegulidwa Distant Horizons idzapanga mwachangu kwambiri
kuyerekezera kwa terrain surface kuti
idzaze render distance.

Surface ikapangidwa, Distant Horizons
idzapanga ndiye ma chunks aliwonse monga momwe
"distantGeneratorMode" config yanu ikulongosola kuti
mupeze mitengo ndi nyumba zina.

Ndizolimbikitsidwa kuzimitsa kusankha kumeneku
ngati muli ndi dziko losiyana kwenikweni,
kuti musaone terrain wamba.
Onetsani Kupita kwa Generation
Timatsimikiza momwe kupita kwa distant generator kuyenera kuwonetsedwa.
Kupita Kwakutali kwa Progress Display Mu Masekondi
Timatsimikiza kuti ziwonetsero zapakati pa zowonetsera zitenga nthawi yayitali bwanji.
Masekondi Owonetsera Zobisira Kupita

Kwa masekondi angati malangizo oletsa kupita kwa distant generator ayenera kuwonetsedwa?
Kukhazikitsa izi ku 0 kumabisa uthenga wophunzitsa kuti kupita kwa world gen kuwonetsedwe nthawi yomweyo kukayamba.
Onetsani Liwiro la Generation mu Chunks/Sekondi

Polembapo kupita kwa generation kuphatikizanso liwiro lomwe chunks
akupangidwa.
Izi zingakhale zothandiza pakuthana ndi mavuto a performance.
Letsani Ngati Server Sikulimba

Ngati thread ya Minecraft server ikutenga nthawi yayitali
Distant Horizons idzapumitsa world gen kuti ichepetse stuttering/lag ya server.
Pumitsani Ngati Mukusuntha Mwachangu

Ngati wosewera/kamera akusuntha mwachangu
Distant Horizons idzapumitsa world gen kuti ipititse patsogolo kutsitsa
ndikuchepetsa lag.
Surface Regen Max Distance Percent

Kuchuluka kwa mtunda wonse wa kujambula kwa LOD
kuti pass yachiwiri ya fast surface generator idzadzaze
ndi chunks opangidwa monga momwe
"distantGeneratorMode" yanuyo ikulongosola.
distanthorizons.config.common.lodBuildin:
Kuletsa kuyeza kumeneku kungathe kuthana ndi mavuto omwe LOD sizisinthidwa pambuyo
pakuti blocks asinthidwa.

Kodi algorithm iti iyenera kugwiritsidwa ntchito kutumphunzitsa data yatsopano ya LOD?
Kusankha kumeneku kumangokhudza data yatsopano kapena yosinthidwa ya LOD,
data iliyonse yomwe yapangidwa kale pamene kusankha kumeneku kusinthidwa
idzakhala yosasinthidwa mpaka idzalembeledwenso mu database.

Yofulumira Kwambiri: LZ4
Kupondereza Kwakukulu: LZMA2

Kodi block data iyenera kuponderezedwa bwanji popanga data ya LOD?
Kusankha kumeneku kumangokhudza data yatsopano kapena yosinthidwa ya LOD,
data iliyonse yomwe yapangidwa kale pamene kusankha kumeneku kusinthidwa
idzakhala yosasinthidwa mpaka itasinthidwa kapena kuwerengedwanso.

Yolondola Kwambiri: Merge Same Blocks
Kupondereza Kwakukulu: Visually Equal

Zimafuna kuyambitsanso level kuti zigwire ntchito.

Kukhazikitsa kumeneku ku mode yocheperako kumawonjezera kuthamanga kwa DB read/write
koma theka la kusowa/kutayika kwa data ngati
computer yataya mphamvu zake
(kutseka kwadzidzidzi kwa pulogalamu kuyenera kukhala kotetezeka kwa zosankha zonse).

§6FULL§r
ACID - data sidzatayika kapena kuwonongeka
Yocheperako

§6NORMAL§r
Data ina ingatayike pamene power yatha, koma database sayenera kuwonongeka.
Yothamanga

§6OFF§r
Database ingawonongeke pamene power yatha
Yothamanga Kwambiri
Kukweza LOD Zochepa Kuti Mudzaze Mabowo

Pamene yatsegulidwa, DH idzayesa kudzaza data ya LOD yomwe ikusowa
ndi data iliyonse yomwe ili mu tree, kuletsa mabowo mukasamuka
pamene generator ya N-sized (kapena seva) ikugwira ntchito.

§6ZOYESERA§r Zidzawonjezera kugwiritsa ntchito harddrive ndipo zingayambitse mavuto a kujambula.
Onani config file kuti mumve zambiri.
distanthorizons.config.common.multiThrea: Kodi DH idzagwiritsa ntchito ma threads angati.

Kodi Java thread priority iti iyenera kuthamanga ndi pools a primary threads a DH?

Mwinanso simukufunika kusintha izi pokhapokha ngati mukugwiritsanso
ntchito C2ME ndipo mukuwona thread starvation mu C2ME kapena DH.

Ngati C2ME ilipo, ikani kuchuluka kwa ma threads a DH kuti igwirizane ndi C2ME.

Izi ndi zofunika kuletsa mavuto a thread starvation pamene C2ME ilipo.
